description: Named aerosol phase policies for atmosphere-reference output-impact comparisons. Scalar aerosol presets own AOD, wavelength slope, single-scattering albedo, and scale height; this artifact owns phase shape and g.

sources.citation: PBRT v4, Volume Scattering / Phase Functions.
sources.role: Normalized isotropic and Henyey-Greenstein phase-function definitions and g-domain guidance.

sources.citation: Eric Bruneton, A Qualitative and Quantitative Evaluation of 8 Clear Sky Models, IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics, 2017. arXiv:1612.04336; source constants and Cornette-Shanks formula in ebruneton/clear-sky-models.
sources.role: Clear-sky comparison aerosol phase contract: Cornette-Shanks phase with g 0.7 for the Kider-fit model comparison.

model.phasePolicy: Aerosol phase shape is selected by id and emitted into medium species phase metadata.
model.localConvention: evaluateScatteringPhase records cosTheta = dot(sourceDirectionFromSample, directionFromSampleToCamera); aerosol phase functions use mu = -cosTheta.

provenance.selectionRationale: Zero-aerosol scalar preset still names a phase policy so medium assembly never invents phase metadata.

notes: These policies select aerosol phase shape only; scalar aerosol coefficients remain in aerosol-presets.json.
Cornette-Shanks is the Bruneton/Kider comparison default, while Henyey-Greenstein remains an explicit control.
